title: RESPONSIBILITY: If phone was disconnect without any my request

messages.text: If phone was disconnect without any my request, you could investigate to fix first

Agreed, and you were right: the phone was not locked; my unlock step (C-131) was not needed. From now on I repair first.
- What failed (19:07Z): the phone's test helper (WDA), running since 17:00Z, lost its permission to control Safari.
- The cable never dropped: connected since 18:28Z, no disconnect logged.
- The fix was mine: restarting the test helper at 19:11Z; the menu test (P-170) then started and is at run 5 of 9 now.
- New rule saved for all agents: on a phone link or helper error, I check the logs and restart the helper first.
- You get a step only when the logs prove it is needed (a re-plug or a trust prompt), and it says what they showed.
What you need to do: nothing.
